James II of England: Was deposed in the Glorious Revolution; replaced by his nephew and his daughter, William III and Mary II ; Has descendants to this day
Mary II of England: Ruled jointly with her cousin and husband, William ; Has no descendants
Anne, Queen of Great Britain: Presided over the union of England and Scotland as Great Britain; Her only son to survive infanthood, Prince William, Duke of Gloucester, died young, hence she has no descendants
James Francis Edward Stuart: The House of Stuart ended with the death of his second son, the Cardinal of York; has descendants to this day
